Name: Wiki Links
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you open the wiki ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/[/url]) page in your web browser for the following type of thing by clicking on them:

[list]
[*]Villagers
[*]Farm Animals
[*]Pets
[*]Monsters
[*]Crops
[*]Inventory Items
[*]Placed Objects
[*]Furniture
[/list]
To open the Wiki page, hold down the modifier key (default [b]Right Shift[/b]) while pressing the button for acting on the item (e.g. [b]Right Mouse Button[/b]).

By default, the mod sends the SDV window to the back; if you are using dual monitors, etc., you can turn off this option in the config.

For things that don't have a Wiki page, the Wiki suggests creating one instead.

You can edit config values using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or editing the [b]config.json[/b] file.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
